resources.string: Paste the key from the bot admin
Separate several senders with commas. Only messages from these senders are forwarded.
Connection OK. The server accepted the key.
Wrong secret key (401). Check the key on both sides.
The server answered with HTTP %1$d. Check the URL.
Android needs your permission to read incoming SMS. Tap the button and choose Allow.
The SMS permission is already granted.

Android blocks SMS permission for apps installed outside the Play Store until you allow restricted settings:

1. Open app settings (button below)
2. Tap the ⋮ menu at the top right
3. Choose "Allow restricted settings"
4. Come back here and tap "Grant SMS permission" again
The server URL must start with https://
To turn forwarding on, fill in the URL, the key and at least one sender.
Use HTTPS only. Never share the secret key. Message text is sent only to the server you set and is never written to the log.
